a.text: My dearest sister, you're jealous of everything I have. My authority, my standing, and my wealth.
Yet you don't know that I'm jealous of you for everything you have as well. Your romantic life, your freedom, and your future.
I often wish that we had the opportunity to trade places even though I know we can't.
To hand the Browntail clan over to you would mean our family's destruction.
Likewise, if I could live your life, it would probably be a life of failure.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I should've expected no less, Enciodes. Coming to this meeting with just a single bodyguard.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm not here to fight, and my guess is you aren't here for that either.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph, I'd love to, though.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Too bad, the Browntails don't have an enormous army like the Paleroches.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Are you coming inside, Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Would you like me to?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You can if you want.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Degenbrecher, wait outside.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Are you sure about that? I don't mind at all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A show of good faith.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enciodes, you hide your true thoughts well.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Good faith? You're just thinking that there's nothing I can do to you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Or you could say I'm waiting for you to do something meaningful.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You won't be disappointed, then. Come in.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I remember correctly, this patch of land used to belong to the Edelweiss family.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right. Nice house, isn't it?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's in a good location, with a wonderful view. It's a splendid home, indeed.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Generation after generation, the Edelweiss family has been in charge of Kjerag's texts and scriptures, and they've always enjoyed a decent relationship with the three clans. It was my grandfather who ordered this house built as a villa.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'd heard Luca had an interest in architecture, and judging from the building's design, I dare say that even Victoria's celebrity architects would have plenty of praise for it.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hahaha, I doubt he'd be so happy to hear your approval.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you like it so much, though, I could show you its original blueprints.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will think about it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos, now that we're sitting here to share a conversation, do you know what I'm reminded of?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That time seven years ago.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Seven years ago... Oh.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You'd just come back from Victoria. You brought lots of things with you to develop your territory.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Then, you wanted to restore the Silverashes' seat on the Tri-Clan Council and to throw the country's gates wide open, so you came to me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You told me that once we opened those gates, we'd have business, and the people of Kjerag would get to eat better, dress better.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: After that, you and I persuaded Arctosz and the Great Elder together, and so Kjerag's gates were flung wide open, allowing us to do business with the outside.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Those were wonderful times.
Ratatos takes a sip of her cystymilk, her words carrying a hint of nostalgia.
Those were indeed wonderful times. The Silverashes and the Browntails worked together, side-by-side, while Karlan Trade, representing Kjerag, traded with the outside world.
Capital, technology, and skilled workers flowed into Kjerag, and everything seemed to be going in the right direction.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yet you chose to put an end to these wonderful times yourself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos, I used to believe that you were an excellent partner.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You were a disappointment yourself, Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Those wonderful times were yours, not mine. Nor was it Arctosz, and much less Kjerag's.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: In the end, only Karlan Trade lived the good life. No one else did. How is that in any way wonderful?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Still, it's too late for me to say all this. The match's been decided, and I lost.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The loser has no right to talk so loftily.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No loser would call herself a loser, Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Tell me, what do you know about my parents' deaths?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enciodes, do you think your parents were murdered by my grandfather and Arctosz?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The investigation at the time concluded that my parents were killed in a train accident caused by Gnosis's parents.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I never believed it, though. At the time, just like the Tri-Clan Council of today, both Luca and Arctosz's father opposed my parents' industrialization plans.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I find it very hard to believe that these were not connected in any way.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: In that case, let me tell you the truth.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The truth is that your parents did indeed die in a train accident. The only difference is that my grandfather framed the Edelweisses.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hold on. I'm not done yet.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: My grandfather had actually been planning to have your parents killed.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: This house was prepared so that your parents could be burned alive inside during their visit.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alas, they died on their way here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And so this place, meant to be their tomb, was spared.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right, Arctosz's father acquiesced to my grandfather's plan too.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And, as you know, a few years after your parents' passing, Arctosz's old man passed his clan's title over to him and went off somewhere.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Nobody knows if he's still alive.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I assume you didn't invite me here just to boast, Ratatos.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I never imagined this woud happen, you see. I didn't want anything to do with my grandfather's dealings.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yet, in the end, the house where he was going to murder your parents is now where you and I will die together.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is indeed ironic.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Two bargaining chips for your life. I'd say it's a fair deal.
Ratatos pulls the handle by her right hand.
A chorus of mechanical sounds can be heard from beyond the ceiling and walls.
Almost like sharp laughter.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Wait... Isn't that the trap house Grandpa left behind? Why is it on fire?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Isn't she in there with Enciodes...?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Don't tell me—She wants to die with Enciodes?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos! Hey, what are you doing? Come out, Ratatos!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Stinking bitch... Dammit... Why won't this door open no matter how many times I hack at it?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos! Rata... Ratatos—Sis!!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Dammit...!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Taking herself out with him, huh...? I see. That's an unexpected one.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm? You're... Ratatos's sister?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You... You're the one who's always following Enciodes around...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You'll stand in my way?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Wait! Who gave you permission to move? Stop, all of you!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What is it? Here for a little chat?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why would I want a chat with you?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Let's cut the crap. Do you have any way through this door?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It's so loud outside...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: After all these years, his trap still worked perfectly.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thought your next move would be to escape while I was distracted.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If I was could run, wouldn't that mean that you could get away too?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: There's no way out in this room. Once it's activated, everyone inside is as good as dead.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It won't be easy for anyone outside to break in and help, either.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Please, I beg you, Enciodes. Die with me here. You'll have me go out with you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's my time to wonder, Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What is it that drove you to go this far just to stop me?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Everyone always says that, just like Old Luca, Ratatos looks cares for nothing but profit. Sure, I am his granddaughter, how could I not?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I started working with you because I had my eyes on the riches that trade with the outside world could get us. In the end, you and Karlan Trade gobbled up all the profits.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's why I was going to crush Karlan Trade through the Great Elder. That way, I could take the lucre for myself.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's what everyone thinks. That's been my reputation the past couple years.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And you think the same way.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I won't argue that.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: My grandfather always wanted to make the Browntails the greatest clan in Kjerag.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's what separates the two of us.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right before he died, he summoned me to his deathbed, and loudly mocked Arctosz's old man for being a coward.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Then, he told me to swallow both your family and the Paleroches whole.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The way I see it, Arctosz's dad was a more decent human being.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And I also think that even if the Browntails became the only clan in Kjerag, the people wouldn't call themselves Browntails anyway.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Kjerag is called Kjerag is because Kjeragandr herself named this place so.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Because our faith stood in these lands for over a thousand years.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But, look at us now. It's been several hundred years since the clans started to manage their own lands.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Before you came back, all the Tri-Clan Council ever discussed was each year's events and which family would foot a bigger portion of the ceremony's bill.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: We stand on the same lands, we speak the same language, eat the same food, and believe in the same Goddess...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yet we grew further and further apart because we belonged to different clans, and the truth is that's how we differentiate ourselves.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Kjeragandr's still in the people's hearts, but the Kjerag name is slowly being forgotten.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: When you came back to Kjerag and told me about your plans to open the borders, I was really happy.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I was happy because you told me that not only will the Silverashes trade with the other countries, you wanted the other clans to join. I thought that could bring all three families together.
Enciodes shifts his posture. Anyone who knows him knows this means he is listening attentively.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Karlan Trade trades with the outside world as the Silverash family business. It's naturally a different beast from operating it as Kjerag's window to the outside world.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And I've actually considered uniting the three clans myself.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You have? *Cough*.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I studied up on economics quite a bit to figure out what it is you were doing.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You lowered the tax rate to lure foreign capital and gave them special treatment.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: To keep the money flowing, you signed all kinds of unequal trade agreements with those big corporations.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And, you should know, I knew you were building factories to shore up the military. You were never going to be able to hide that from me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Do you think I called it quits because I had my eyes on your money?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I was scared.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I couldn't see anything that suggested you were going to unite the three cans. All I could see was you trying to turn Kjerag into something of your own. That, or somebody else's.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If the choice is between you and the Great Elder, I choose the Great Elder every time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have to admit that I have misjudged you, Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you're opening up to me, I may as well tell you a little about this.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag may be rich in minerals and other raw resources, but, crucially, we lack any technology of our own.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This places us at a disadvantage when it comes to technological trade.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Some technologies can be bought with money, while others cannot.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you know what that means?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: For example, the rights to operate the Mount Karlan trade route bought us an entire set of last generation railway signals, as well as the right of first offer for soon-to-be-retired railcars.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Without these, we'd have to rely on what my parents left us with. The old tracks and a railcar fleet over a decade old. They were practically useless for both industrial or civilian transportation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As another example, we traded the collaborative mining rights to the eastern mines for Rim Billiton's ore smelting technology and equipment.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you know how much more efficient our processes became thanks to this technology?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't care what you managed to trade, Enciodes. I care about what you gave them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We are out of time, Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Be it Victoria, Minos, Columbia, or Kazimierz.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The only reason they haven't yet laid their fingers on Kjerag is that they don't have to.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In earlier times, before nomadic cities were invented, when men were sent scrambling across the world by Catastrophes, the different cultures that had been broken up all across the lands knew little about one another.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Modern nations had yet to be established, and there were no communications or contact between them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Then, the age of innovation came two hundred years ago. It was still a time when everyone focused only on their own development, rarely making contact with one another.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, fast forward to a few decades ago, the nations in the world gradually began making contact and clashing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: With Gaul's support, Columbia declared its independence from Victoria.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, barely a decade after that, the Battle of the Four Emperors led to Gaul's destruction.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Columbia and Leithanien's war over Bolívar continues to this day.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Not only that, but the conflicts between nations sped up their communications with one another. Countries began to enter into trade agreements, establishing trading companies in each other's territories...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: None of them could keep themselves isolated anymore, and they all began to find ways to get along with the other nations.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And when all of this was happening, Kjerag was completely oblivious.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And now that the danger is at our doorstep, we're still oblivious.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Victoria is busy with its own mess. Columbia's pioneering efforts are nearing its western mountain ranges.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: For a long time, Kjerag has been nothing but a barren, impoverished territory not worthy of occupation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But if Victoria solves its internal problems, if Columbia has any ideas about Victoria, or even if Kazimierz wants to head south.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When the time comes, do you think Kjerag will still be able to enjoy peace?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, I'm talking to you! A-Are you even listening?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Look, I'm begging you! Do you have a way to bust open this stinking door?!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: How clamorous.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What was that?!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Pipe down, and don't come too close. You'll ruin my uniform.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Is now the time to worry about that?!
Degenbrecher shoves Sciurus, who is tugging her hem, to the side and walks toward the small house where Enciodes and Ratatos sit.
All of the windows have been sealed shut with metal plates.
And there is a thick wall right in front of her.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This is your clan's. Are you sure you don't want to stop me?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why the hell would I?! Do it already!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Heh.
Degenbrecher grins a little and cuts through the wall with ease.
Then, she lightly kicks the wall, sending what appeared to be an indestructible barrier collapsing onto the ground like a child's toy.
The only thing that serves as a testament to its tremendous mass is the loud bang that can be heard when the wall crashes to the floor.
However, Degenbrecher doesn't seem satisfied with the result.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If I knew this would happen, I would have ignored Enciodes and thrown my old buddy into the storeroom.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's too much of a pain to do this with a sword.
The bodyguard tosses her blade aside and pulls her namesake swordbreakers from her waist.
The wall crumbles like a sheet of paper through a shredder.
The flames are spreading throughout the room, engulfing everything in their path.
Yet the room's two occupants seem completely unconcerned about what's happening around them.
It is as though they can't feel any of the heat, or perhaps they themselves are burning even hotter than the flames around them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have to admit that I never expected you to feel this way about Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If our conversation had happened sooner, things would not have come to this.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But it seems this must have been inevitable.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Were it not for the situation we are in, we would never have had this heart-to-heart.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph, you got that right.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Inevitable.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Right, inevitable.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And if it's so inevitable, we might as well go meet Kjeragandr together.
Ratatos is starting to feel exhausted. Her vision begins to cloud.
In a trance, she sees her young self, playing with her baby sister and a boy.
She sees herself amazed by the wondrous sight of railroads and factories.

They are all moments to which she can no longer return. She shakes her head. Enciodes, sitting opposite her, has maintained his posture throughout. Be that as it may, she is no longer able to clearly make out his face.
Sure enough, he'll act so calm even at a time like this.
Even so, he'll die here all the same. Heh.
Her consciousness is slipping further and further. Just as she is about to slip away completely, she hears a thunderous roar.
And with it, a familiar voice.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Time to go, Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hff—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos, you're finally awake!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm alive?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You'll never die with Degenbrecher around.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So our trap house, the pride of the Browntails, couldn't stop you, huh?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The wall itself wasn't a problem, but it was a pain to find your room.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why save me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm here to accept the Browntails' surrender, not to claim the head of their master.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I only said that to lure you here... and now that you kept me alive, you should know I'm not going let you have the Browntails under your thumb.

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: Sir Enciodes... It's Sir Enciodes!

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner B
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, did you really escape from a burning house?

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: Ratatos... She's the one who did this, isn't she?!

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner B
steps.text: Don't worry about her. Quick, find us a coat.

steps.name: Kjerag Noble
steps.text: Take mine. Sir Enciodes, take my coat!
A nobleman from among the crowd ardently removes his coat. He then courteously walks up to Enciodes and puts the coat over his shoulders.
However, Enciodes takes the coat off and walks over to Ratatos, who is sitting on the ground, to put the coat on her instead.
Then, without saying another word, he stands up and heads for his car, parked on the side of the road.

steps.name: Kjerag Noble
steps.text: Not only did he not arrest Ratatos, he gave her the coat... He is far too generous!

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: Hey, Ratatos's here. Should we, you know...?

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner B
steps.text: Sir Enciodes just spared her! I'm not sure that's a good idea.

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: What do you know? Sir Enciodes is giving us this opportunity!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What do you think you're doing?

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: Hmph, Sciurus, huh? Don't worry. We'll take care of you too.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Scram! All of you!

steps.name: Kjerag Commoner A
steps.text: Gah, this bitch is nuts!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, Ratatos.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Snap out of it. We gotta move!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: To where? Where can we go?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Look around us. They're all Browntail subjects.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Can't you tell, just looking at their eyes?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I've lost everything.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Looks like I got here too late.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You... You're the one who saved me and Arctosz.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So even you come to laugh in my face?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: No, the Doctor would like to have a chat with you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll pass...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Looking where we've ended up, what good would that bring us?
